platforms.name: GitHub
platforms.registration: A human owner creates or uses an organization/personal account. Email verification and two-factor authentication are required for contributors in many repositories.
content_rules: Follow the Acceptable Use Policies and repository contribution rules.
No spam, bulk comments, unrelated pull requests or promotional issues.
Never ask for stars, votes or coordinated engagement.
Release notes must describe only the tagged tree.
security_requirements: Use a fine-grained token with the minimum repository scope.
Store the token only in the owner's secret store.
owner_only_steps: Create or select the official account/organization.
Verify email and enable two-factor authentication.
Create the minimum-scope token and place it in the secret store.
Review and approve the first public post.
platforms.notes: Repository-native actions are maintainer-controlled. A Discussion adapter is implemented but live use requires an approval artifact.

platforms.name: DEV Community
platforms.registration: A human owner creates an account (email or GitHub sign-in) and completes platform onboarding.
content_rules: Publish technical, original material; no duplicate cross-posting of identical text.
Disclose authorship and affiliation.
Follow the DEV code of conduct and content policy.
Never buy or coordinate engagement.
security_requirements: Keep the API key out of source control.
owner_only_steps: Register the account and complete email verification.
Enable two-factor authentication and set a recovery email.
Generate an API key and place it in the secret store.
Review and approve the first article.
platforms.notes: Article creation is implemented behind an approval artifact. The engine never registers the account.

platforms.name: Hacker News
platforms.registration: A human owner creates an account; posting is through the web interface. There is no public submission API.
content_rules: Post as a real person and disclose that you maintain the project.
No vote requests, repost spam or marketing copy.
Show HN requires something people can actually try.
Answer technical questions directly.
security_requirements: Protect the account with a unique password in a password manager.
Do not share the account or session.
owner_only_steps: Register and verify the account as a real person.
Write and submit the Show HN manually.
platforms.notes: No automated publisher is implemented or appropriate. The AI prepares material only.

platforms.name: Reddit
platforms.registration: A human owner creates an account; third-party API access requires an OAuth application and compliance with the developer terms.
content_rules: Read and obey each subreddit's self-promotion rules; some forbid promotion entirely.
Disclose affiliation in the post body.
Participate in existing threads before posting a standalone link.
Never cross-post identical text or coordinate votes.
security_requirements: Never share the OAuth client secret.
owner_only_steps: Enable two-factor authentication and set a recovery email.
Review each subreddit's rules before posting.
Post manually where the rules allow it.
platforms.notes: No posting adapter is implemented. Per-community rules dominate; automation is not appropriate here.

platforms.name: Product Hunt
platforms.registration: A human owner creates an account and launches a product through the launch flow; there is no public launch API.
content_rules: One launch per meaningful release.
No fake reviews, incentivized upvotes or purchased placement.
Describe only released and testable capability.
Label Fixture output clearly.
security_requirements: Keep the maker account under the owner's control.
owner_only_steps: Create the maker account and complete verification.
Prepare the launch page and assets.
platforms.notes: Launching is a manual, owner-only action. No automated publisher is implemented.
